consensus of Illumina genome reads baited to V4 and voted to convergence (bin/reads_v4_consensus.py, seed A. caninum MT764922): SRR39566487 (individual L3 larvae, 2026; ~1,350x) and SRR1124846 (2014 genome project, adults; ~390x) give the identical insert, both primers exact. It is the V4 A. caninum and A. duodenale share (V4_1b4534ba7609), so A. ceylanicum is named to genus only. Method checked on A. duodenale reads (SRR32380613): recovers the PacBio-confirmed V4 exactly, and corrects a seed with 8 planted errors in one round. Minor alleles in the larvae run (positions 313-318, <=4% each) are noise: absent from the adult run and from A. duodenale PacBio reads

consensus of Illumina genome reads (bin/reads_v4_consensus.py, seed O. cervicalis DQ094174): O. volvulus SRR9962982 (Ghana, 649x) - insert position 123 is A in 443 reads and C in 248; Cameroon SRR24879666 and Mali SRR25381927 carry C, the existing Onchocerca record. D. repens also has A there, so without this variant an O. volvulus read carrying A is 1 edit from both Onchocerca and D. repens. Position 347 (C; Loa has A), the base that separates Onchocerca from Loa, is C in all three isolates and in O. lupi HiFi reads (ERR15297753)

consensus of Illumina genome reads (bin/reads_v4_consensus.py, seed O. cervicalis DQ094174, mammalian 18S decoy): O. ochengi ERR068354 (2012 genome project, 94x) - identical to O. volvulus (Cameroon, Mali isolates) and the existing Onchocerca record, so V4 does not separate O. ochengi from O. volvulus. ERR2203773 (2017) gave too few reads (median 7x) to use

consensus of Illumina genome reads (bin/reads_v4_consensus.py, seed A. caninum MT764922): H. placei carries two V4 variants in about equal amounts, differing at insert position 138 - G in 1,065 of 2,104 reads (SRR24442206, 2023) and 2,105 of 3,905 (ERR066169, 2012). This G variant is in no other record: the H. contortus genome (WBPS PRJEB506) has A in 12 of its 13 copies (its one G copy differs at 8 other positions). Reads carrying it name H. placei

the other H. placei variant (A at insert position 138; 1,039 and 1,800 reads in SRR24442206 and ERR066169): identical to the V4 H. placei shares with H. contortus and H. similis (PR2 L04154/L04153/L04152), so reads carrying it stop at Haemonchus
